content_review.reviewer: Codex exact-taxon source, bilingual and range audit
content_review.notes: Every English and Chinese section was compared line by line; exact-taxon identity, conservation mapping, numeric claims, visual identification risks and generalized range geometry were checked against the cited sources. Polygon boundaries are display generalizations and never imply continuous occupancy.

conservation_status.note_en: No species-level global IUCN assessment was confirmed. Not Evaluated means assessment is absent, not that the species is secure or abundant.
conservation_status.note_zh: 未确认到物种级IUCN全球评估。未评估表示缺少评估，并不表示该物种安全或数量丰富。

description.en: Maratus volans is the classic Peacock Spider: a tiny eastern Australian jumping spider whose male unfolds red, blue and black abdominal flaps and waves his third legs in a precise courtship dance. Females are cryptically brown and far harder to identify from photographs.
description.zh: Maratus volans是经典孔雀跳蛛：一种澳大利亚东部微小跳蛛，雄蛛求偶时展开红蓝黑色腹部侧瓣并挥动第三对足，完成精确舞蹈。雌蛛为隐蔽棕色，单凭照片更难鉴定。

anatomy.en: Adults are only about 4–5 mm long. Males have iridescent scale-like hairs and expandable lateral flaps on the abdomen plus conspicuous brushes on the raised third legs; females lack the fan and are mottled brown.
anatomy.zh: 成蛛仅约4–5毫米。雄蛛腹部有虹彩鳞片状毛和可展开侧瓣，抬起的第三对足有醒目毛刷；雌蛛没有扇面，呈斑驳棕色。

ecology_and_behavior.en: A diurnal visual hunter, it stalks small insects and other arthropods on low vegetation and leaf litter rather than using a prey-catching web. Silk is used for safety lines, retreats and egg sacs.
ecology_and_behavior.zh: 它是日行视觉猎手，在低植被和落叶层追踪小昆虫及其他节肢动物，而不用捕猎网。丝用于安全绳、隐蔽巢和卵囊。

habitat_and_distribution.en: Confirmed from eastern Australia, especially coastal and near-coastal southern Queensland and New South Wales, with records extending into nearby southeastern regions. Peacock spiders have small and species-specific ranges; broad Australia-wide genus maps must not be substituted for M. volans.
habitat_and_distribution.zh: 确认分布于澳大利亚东部，尤以昆士兰南部和新南威尔士沿海及近海地区为主，并延伸到邻近东南区域。孔雀跳蛛各物种范围小且特异，不能用整个属的澳洲广布图代替M. volans。

value.en: Active visual pursuit; no prey-catching web
value.zh: 主动视觉追猎；不用捕猎网

value.en: Abdominal fan plus raised third legs
value.zh: 展开腹扇并抬起第三对足

life_cycle_and_reproduction.en: A male approaches a female with vibrations, raised legs and a fully expanded abdominal fan. If accepted, mating follows; the female later encloses eggs in a silk retreat and guards them until spiderlings emerge.
life_cycle_and_reproduction.zh: 雄蛛以振动、抬足和完全展开的腹扇接近雌蛛。若被接受便交配；雌蛛之后把卵包在丝质隐蔽巢中，并守护至幼蛛出现。

detail.en: Large forward eyes resolve prey and the fine movements of a courtship partner.
detail.zh: 大型前向眼能分辨猎物和求偶对象的细微动作。

detail.en: Abdominal side flaps transform a tiny male into a broad, colorful signal during courtship.
detail.zh: 腹部侧瓣在求偶时把微小雄蛛变成宽阔鲜艳的视觉信号。

detail.en: A trailing dragline arrests a fall after a leap from vegetation.
detail.zh: 跳离植被后，拖曳丝线可在跌落时提供保护。

ecological_role.en: As a small arthropod predator, it removes springtails, flies and other tiny prey from ground-layer communities and in turn feeds larger spiders, insects, reptiles and birds.
ecological_role.zh: 作为小型节肢动物捕食者，它捕食落叶层中的跳虫、蝇类等微小猎物，同时又供更大的蜘蛛、昆虫、爬行动物和鸟类取食。

threats.en: Not Evaluated globally. Because records are localized, habitat clearing, frequent burning, pesticide use and collection could matter even when no formal population trend exists.
threats.zh: 全球未评估。由于记录局限，生境清除、频繁火烧、农药和采集即使在没有正式种群趋势时也可能产生重要影响。

actions.en: Retain diverse low vegetation and litter, avoid indiscriminate pesticides, document exact localities without exposing fragile micro-sites, and base photography or collection on permits and minimal disturbance.
actions.zh: 应保留多样低植被和落叶层，避免无差别农药，记录准确地点但不暴露脆弱微地点，并在许可和最小干扰原则下摄影或采集。

key_features.en: Adult male: red-and-blue patterned abdominal fan edged in white, black bands and long decorated third legs raised during display. The fan pattern of M. volans must match exactly.
key_features.zh: 成年雄蛛：腹部扇面红蓝相间、白边并有黑带，求偶时抬起装饰延长的第三对足。M. volans的扇面图案必须准确匹配。

similar_species.en: Dozens of Maratus species have colorful fans, and females can be nearly inseparable without genital examination. A colorful peacock spider photo is not sufficient: exact male pattern and southeastern locality must agree.
similar_species.zh: 数十种孔雀跳蛛都有彩色扇面，雌蛛若不检查生殖器可能几乎无法区分。仅有“彩色孔雀蛛”照片不够；雄蛛精确图案和东南部地点都必须一致。

communication_and_senses.en: Forward principal eyes provide detailed color vision, while side eyes detect movement. Males combine visual choreography with substrate vibrations that females perceive through their legs.
communication_and_senses.zh: 前方主眼提供精细色觉，侧眼探测运动。雄蛛把视觉舞步与基质振动结合，雌蛛通过足部感知。

seasonal_calendar.en: Adult courtship is most visible in warm spring and summer when prey and mates are active. Eggs develop in guarded silk retreats; timing varies with local temperature and rainfall.
seasonal_calendar.zh: 温暖春夏猎物和配偶活跃时最容易见到成蛛求偶。卵在受守护的丝巢中发育，时间随当地温度和降雨变化。

relationship_with_humans.en: Viral dance videos made peacock spiders conservation ambassadors, but they also encourage mislabeling and collecting. Macro photographers should avoid trampling tiny habitat patches or repeatedly provoking displays.
relationship_with_humans.zh: 求偶舞蹈视频让孔雀跳蛛成为保护明星，也带来误标和采集。微距摄影者应避免踩踏微小生境或反复刺激展示。

evolution.en: Peacock Spider is placed in genus Maratus, family Salticidae, order Araneae. This record follows the accepted binomial Maratus volans and does not transfer claims or images from look-alike species.
evolution.zh: 孔雀跳蛛归入孔雀跳蛛属、跳蛛科、蜘蛛目。本条目采用接受学名Maratus volans，不从外形相近物种移用说法或图片。

field_signs.en: Search sunny low vegetation slowly for a 4–5 mm jumping spider that turns toward movement. Species-level confirmation usually requires a mature displaying male photographed sharply from above and the side with locality data.
field_signs.zh: 应在阳光下低矮植被中缓慢寻找会转向运动目标的4–5毫米跳蛛。物种级确认通常需要清晰拍摄成熟展示雄蛛的背面和侧面，并有地点数据。

text.en: The name volans means 'flying,' based on an old mistaken idea that the flaps aided flight.
text.zh: 种加词volans意为“飞行”，源自早期误以为侧瓣能帮助飞行。

text.en: The male's dance is both visual and vibrational.
text.zh: 雄蛛的舞蹈同时包含视觉和振动信号。

text.en: A female may attack a poorly performing male, so courtship precision has real survival stakes.
text.zh: 雌蛛可能攻击表现不佳的雄蛛，因此求偶精度直接关系生存。

content.en: Hydraulic pressure rapidly extends the legs for a leap, while muscle flexes them again. A silk dragline remains attached as insurance during the jump.
content.zh: 体液压力迅速伸展腿部完成跳跃，肌肉再使腿弯曲；跳跃时仍连接丝质拖线作为保险。

habitat.text_en: Confirmed from eastern Australia, especially coastal and near-coastal southern Queensland and New South Wales, with records extending into nearby southeastern regions. Peacock spiders have small and species-specific ranges; broad Australia-wide genus maps must not be substituted for M. volans.
habitat.text_zh: 确认分布于澳大利亚东部，尤以昆士兰南部和新南威尔士沿海及近海地区为主，并延伸到邻近东南区域。孔雀跳蛛各物种范围小且特异，不能用整个属的澳洲广布图代替M. volans。

range_review.comparison_en: This new record has no previous geometry. The displayed nonrectangular polygons are a conservative, simplified tracing of the cited institutional range account for readable world-map display; boundaries are generalized and do not imply continuous occupancy within every enclosed area.
range_review.comparison_zh: 这是没有旧几何的新记录。显示的非矩形多边形依据所引机构分布资料保守概化，以便世界地图清晰呈现；边界为概括范围，不表示圈内每处都有连续分布。
